Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207, Costco's confirmation with the added loading charge is a counteroffer, not an acceptance, so no contract formed unless accepted.

Q6156.reason: The engineer's deposition in the wrongful termination suit was not against the company on the liability issue and lacks a hearsay exception here.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the ECtHR held state immunity did not breach the fair trial right, so immunity prevailed.
